messages:
maria: PTAL — addressed the comments from last review and added a small retry in the flaky smoke test. I pushed fixes and force-pushed the branch. CI is still red on integration, not sure if it's related to my change or a transient. @kevin @alex can you give quick eyes?
kevin: Thanks — will take a look in ~15. quick Q: did you change any interface surface or just test infra?
alex: I can scan now. if it's only test infra we can probably rerun CI and be fine.
ci-bot: Build #4821 — integration failed. Error: timeout waiting for docker image pull in /integration/session_manager_test (attempt 3). Logs: ```Pulling image redis:6.2... stalled at 12%```.
maria: I only changed the test harness retry and a tiny mock fix — no API changes. pushed an extra commit that adds 5s backoff and one extra retry for the redis pull. Triggered a CI rebuild: `rerun build #4822`.
ci-bot: Build #4822 — running...
kevin: thx. if that fails ping infra to increase docker pull timeout, but lgtm otherwise. I'll hold my explicit approve until CI is green.
alex: Scanned the diff — test-only change. added one nit inline about log wording but not blocking. :+1: once CI is green i'll approve.
ci-bot: Build #4822 — success. All checks passed.
kevin: Approved.
alex: Approved and left the nit as optional.
maria: Great, thanks both. @release-ops do we have a merge slot today? This is a low-risk fix and would unblock a downstream canary.
release-ops: We have a slot at 20:30 UTC for small merges before the 21:00 canary window. If you want earlier, we can fast-track to 19:45 but need two approvals (you have them) and a short release note.
maria: 19:45 works — i'll add the release note and mark as cherrypick-safe. merging then unless you say otherwise. :thumbsup:
release-ops: Scheduling 19:45. Will watch the merge and kick off the short canary. If anything flakes we'll roll back.
maria: Thanks! I'll queue the PR and add the note in the PR body.
kevin: nice, thanks for the quick turnaround.
alex: Thanks — glad that flaky test is less brittle now.
ci-bot: Merge queued for 19:45 UTC.```
